about: [O4] The jank walk of a fight in the diner (WAVE_C §7.5): the men held at their ring, I walk into the counter, a stool, a cafe table, a man standing, the back wall; one of them knocked down and I walk across where he lies (the body blocks nobody's feet); the other walks his ring over him. By real input.

steps.until: G.scenes.current && G.scenes.current.id === 'o4' && G.scenes.beat === 'diner' && G.crowd.active && !G.failing && document.pointerLockElement === N.renderer.domElement

steps.walk: (() => { const e = G.eye; const m = G.crowd.men.filter((x) => x.state !== 'down').sort((a, b) => Math.hypot(a.c.pos.x - e.x, a.c.pos.z - e.z) - Math.hypot(b.c.pos.x - e.x, b.c.pos.z - e.z))[0]; return [[m.c.pos.x, m.c.pos.z]]; })()

steps.name: into the cafe table by B3
one man down: walked across where he lies

steps.eval: (() => { const m = G.crowd.men[1]; G.crowd.knockDown(m, new N.THREE.Vector3(0, 0, 1)); return [m.state, +m.c.pos.x.toFixed(2), +m.c.pos.z.toFixed(2)]; })()
(() => { const b = G.crowd.men[1].c.bones.hips.getWorldPosition(new N.THREE.Vector3()); window.__body = [b.x, b.z]; return window.__body.map((v) => +v.toFixed(2)); })()

steps.walk: (() => { const [x0, z] = window.__body; const x = Math.max(-13.2, Math.min(-10.85, x0)); window.__lane = x; return [[x, z - 1.0], [x, z + 1.0]]; })()

steps.expect: (() => { const [, z] = window.__body; return N.controller.pos.z > z + 0.6; })()

steps.name: the back wall, the counter's far end
